subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The Rungrado is the __large__ football stadium in the world.
solution:
```html
The correct answer is '**largest**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The word "**largest**" is the superlative form of the adjective "**large**."
 
• The sentence is describing the Rungrado football stadium as the biggest stadium in the world. Hence, the superlative form "**largest**" is required.
 
• **Options 1, 2, and 3** are grammatically incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"The Rungrado is the **largest**__ football stadium in the world."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "most largest"** is incorrect because "most" and "largest" cannot be combined as they both indicate a superlative degree.
 
• **Option 2: "more larger"** is incorrect because "more" and "larger" cannot be used together in this context.
 
• **Option 3: "larger"** is incorrect as it is a comparative form and does not fit the superlative meaning required here.

``
